name: feature.service-desk.nodes
description: Service-desk ticket reads over ctx.features['service-desk'] (ADR 0422): list the org queue and read one ticket incl. its thread, so SLA/escalation workflows can branch on ticket state. Writes stay on the approval lane (draft-reply) and the reply-approved event binding — never a node. role:action (recorded).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Service Desk: List Tickets
nodes.description: Lists the org's tickets (id/subject/status/priority/channel/message count) over ctx.features['service-desk'].listTickets. Inputs: { orgId, status? }. Output: { tickets }. Tenant-guarded read.

nodes.label: Service Desk: Get Ticket
nodes.description: Reads one ticket incl. the message thread over ctx.features['service-desk'].getTicket. Inputs: { ticketId }. Output: { ticket | null }. Tenant-guarded read.
